stop_if: Any file outside the eight listed files and package.json changes.
Any package.json change beyond the single flag, or removal/reordering/alteration of an existing checked path/token.
A format failure remains beyond the documented package/file scope.
Any product, generated, snapshot, report, fact, Fumadocs boundary, external, commit, push, or deploy action is needed.

evidence: Scope matched the Paper & Slate web workspace and exact board path.
Current format:check reported exactly eight style mismatches and one unmatched tests/**/*.tsx error.
